[Problem]{.card-kicker} **Make Sum Divisible by P** [LC 1590 · Make Sum Divisible by P](https://leetcode.com/problems/make-sum-divisible-by-p/){difficulty="Medium"}

Let $R = \bigl(\sum a\bigr) \bmod p$. Removing the middle piece $a[\ell..r]$ is divisible-by-$p$ exactly when $\text{pref}_r - \text{pref}_{\ell-1} \equiv R \pmod p$, where $\text{pref}$ is the prefix-sum remainder array of @sec-pref — rearranged: $\text{pref}_{\ell-1} \equiv \text{pref}_r - R$. So for each right end $r$, you need the **latest** earlier prefix with remainder $(\text{pref}_r - R) \bmod p$, because latest ⇒ shortest window. A map from remainder to latest index answers it in one pass — @sec-hash-complement's seen table wearing @sec-pref's clothes; the bookkeeping rule `last = {0: -1}` says "prefix of length zero, remainder $0$, sits at index $-1$".

[Solved in full in @sec-hash-p5-b.]{.card-link}
